purpose: Plan the LPC promotion order for tile families that assemble against their own kind: roads, paths, bridges, caves, floors, walls, cliffs, and modular structures.
runtimeSafety: Pass106 is a planning and validation pass only; it does not change renderer placement behavior.
A resolved cell may use one complete replacement role at a time.
Do not layer complete replacement cells over one another to fake mixed topology.
Mixed edge-plus-diagonal visuals stay deferred until a source family provides authored cells for that exact topology.

sameFamilyRoleRequirements.description: Minimum authored role coverage before a same-family group can be promoted from mapping-required to production paint.
notes: The first production cut can use the cardinal 16-mask set plus a repeatable center fill.
Diagonal context can be preserved for future authored mixed roles, but must not trigger layered full-tile replacement.

promotionTasks: Choose one LPC-compatible authored source family per material.
Map center fill, end caps, straights, corners, tees, and cross roles.
Generate a complete 16-mask same-family atlas from authored cells.
Validate that bridges connect to roads/paths without pretending water is part of the same family.
Expose production road/path paint only after every role is verified.
Map floor continuity separately from wall/cap continuity.
Keep cave wall collision/walkability separate from visual wall assembly.
Promote cave floors before cave walls if wall roles are incomplete.
Keep floor assembly, wall assembly, and roof/building exterior modules as separate families.
Require clear wall caps and corners before enabling production wall paint.
Reserve doors, windows, counters, and trim as stamps or derived overlays.
Map cliff faces, caps, inside corners, outside corners, and scene-edge endings.
Keep mountain rocks that behave like props out of same-family terrain assembly.
Do not use cliff cells to solve beach, road, or cave transitions.

editorExposure.sameFamilyFamilies: Hidden or marked Mapping Required until their group reaches verified authored role coverage.
editorExposure.derivedFamilies: Not direct paint buttons; generated from neighboring terrain or simulation state.
editorExposure.objectFamilies: Placed through object or stamp workflows, not terrain paint.

nextImplementationPass: Audit actual source cells for road_path_bridge.
Generate preview boards for each required role before wiring renderer selection.
Only then bind roads and paths to production editor paint.
